key_finding: Full 4-date-dimension lot expiry tracking (expiration, best-before, removal, alert) with FEFO removal strategy, scheduler-driven alert activities, soft-block on expired-lot shipments via confirmation wizard, GS1 barcode integration, and automatic expiry date population at receipt.

claims_summary.topic: Module depends solely on stock
use_expiration_date gate flag on product.template; forced False when tracking removed
Four integer offset fields on product.template for all date dimensions
stock.lot gains four stored datetime fields: expiration_date, use_date, removal_date, alert_date
expiration_date auto-set on lot creation as now() + expiration_time
Derived dates recalculated on expiration_date change using delta or template offsets
product_expiry_alert flag becomes True when expiration_date <= now()
stock.move.line carries stored expiration_date and removal_date propagated from lot or auto-computed
Receipt auto-populates expiration_date on move lines from scheduled_date + expiration_time
Picking validation intercepted; expired lots trigger confirmation wizard
Expired-lot check is a soft block; user may proceed or strip expired lines
Scheduler hook in stock.rule calls _alert_date_exceeded() during replenishment scheduler
Alert activities assigned to product responsible user; product_expiry_reminded prevents repeats
FEFO orders quants by removal_date asc, then in_date, then id
FEFO product.removal record seeded by module data XML
Quants past removal_date report available_quantity = 0
Reservation passes with_expiration date context to exclude past-removal quants
GS1 barcode includes AI 17 (expiry) and AI 15 (best-before) when expiry tracking enabled
Enabling lot tracking in settings auto-activates product_expiry module
Lot display name optionally shows --Expired-- or --Expire on <date>-- suffix

architectural_notes.blocking_behaviour: SOFT BLOCK — validation intercepted but user can override via wizard; skip_expired context flag bypasses re-check
architectural_notes.fefo_integration: removal_date field drives FEFO sort order in _get_removal_strategy_order; zero available_quantity for past-removal quants
architectural_notes.scheduler_integration: Plugged into stock.rule._run_scheduler_tasks(); one-shot activity scheduling with product_expiry_reminded flag
architectural_notes.no_hard_cron: No standalone ir.cron record; uses stock replenishment scheduler pipeline via stock.rule hook
